info.name: 1D Convolutional Autoencoder
info.description: A 1D convolutional autoencoder based anomaly detection model for time-series data. Use with the Raw data processing block.

parameters.name: Number of training cycles
parameters.help: Number of epochs to train the neural network on.

parameters.name: Learning rate
parameters.help: How fast the neural network learns, if the network overfits quickly, then lower the learning rate.

parameters.name: Kernel size
parameters.help: Convolution kernel size. Allowed values: 3, 5, or 7.

parameters.name: Convolutional layers
parameters.help: Number of Conv1D layers in the encoder. The decoder will use the same number of Conv1DTranspose layers plus one final reconstruction layer (total = N + 1).

parameters.name: Early stopping patience
parameters.help: How many epochs to wait before stopping the training if the validation loss does not improve. If 0, early stopping is disabled.
